description: Create multiple organization memberships in Zendesk by posting up to 100 membership objects at a time. Each membership links a user to an organization. Use when onboarding multiple users to organizations in bulk, such as during team migrations or organizational restructuring. The operation returns a job_status payload; the initial status is typically 'queued' for larger batches.
